description: Unit tests for the AgentWorkspace component, verifying path display, URL resolution, bootstrap process, safety checks, and workspace state management.

classes.name: AgentWorkspaceTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for verifying functionality of AgentWorkspace handling.

methods.name: `display path uses tilde for home`
methods.description: Tests that the displayPath method uses '~' to represent the user's home directory.

methods.name: `resolve workspace URL expands tilde`
methods.description: Verifies that resolveWorkspaceURL expands '~/tmp' to an appropriate URL with the correct suffix.

methods.name: `agents URL appends filename`
methods.description: Checks that agentsURL correctly appends the agents filename to the workspace URL.

methods.name: `bootstrap creates agents file when missing`
methods.description: Ensures bootstrap creates the agents file and associated files if they do not exist.

methods.name: `bootstrap safety rejects non empty folder without agents`
methods.description: Verifies bootstrap safety rejects folders that are non-empty and lack an agents file.

methods.name: `bootstrap safety allows existing agents file`
methods.description: Checks that bootstrap safety passes when an agents file already exists in the workspace.

methods.name: `bootstrap skips bootstrap file when workspace has content`
methods.description: Ensures bootstrap does not overwrite or create bootstrap files if the workspace already contains other files.

methods.name: `needs bootstrap false when identity already set`
methods.description: Verifies that bootstrap is not needed when an identity file with content already exists.
